On Omega, 0<=S<pi/mu (strict at A>0), so the derivative is globally nonpositive iff R0<=mu/(omega+mu), including equality. If that parameter bound fails, S in (S0/R0,pi/mu) and tiny A>0 produce a positive derivative.
